005package org.wpilib.driverstation;
006
007import java.util.Map;
008import java.util.Optional;
009import java.util.OptionalInt;
010import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;
011import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.AllianceStationID;
012import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.DriverStationJNI;
013import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.HAL;
014import org.wpilib.hardware.hal.MatchInfoData;
015
016/** Provides access to match state information from the Driver Station. */
017public final class MatchState {
018  static {
019    HAL.initialize();
020  }
021
022  private static MatchInfoData m_matchInfo = new MatchInfoData();
023  private static MatchInfoData m_matchInfoCache = new MatchInfoData();
024  private static String m_gameData = "";
025  private static final ReentrantLock m_dataMutex = new ReentrantLock();
026
027  private MatchState() {}
028
029  /**
030   * Return the approximate match time. The FMS does not send an official match time to the robots,
031   * but does send an approximate match time. The value will count down the time remaining in the
032   * current period (auto or teleop). Warning: This is not an official time (so it cannot be used to
033   * dispute ref calls or guarantee that a function will trigger before the match ends).
034   *
035   * <p>This number only changes in full integer increments and always counts down, both when
036   * connected to the real field and when the DS is in match mode.
037   *
038   * <p>When the DS is in teleop or autonomous mode, this number returns -1.0.
039   *
040   * <p>Simulation matches DS behavior without an FMS connected.
041   *
042   * @return Time remaining in current match period (auto or teleop) in seconds
043   */
044  public static double getMatchTime() {
045    return DriverStationJNI.getMatchTime();
046  }
047
048  private static Map<AllianceStationID, Optional<Alliance>> m_allianceMap =
049      Map.of(
050          AllianceStationID.UNKNOWN, Optional.empty(),
051          AllianceStationID.RED_1, Optional.of(Alliance.RED),
052          AllianceStationID.RED_2, Optional.of(Alliance.RED),
053          AllianceStationID.RED_3, Optional.of(Alliance.RED),
054          AllianceStationID.BLUE_1, Optional.of(Alliance.BLUE),
055          AllianceStationID.BLUE_2, Optional.of(Alliance.BLUE),
056          AllianceStationID.BLUE_3, Optional.of(Alliance.BLUE));
057
058  private static Map<AllianceStationID, OptionalInt> m_stationMap =
059      Map.of(
060          AllianceStationID.UNKNOWN, OptionalInt.empty(),
061          AllianceStationID.RED_1, OptionalInt.of(1),
062          AllianceStationID.RED_2, OptionalInt.of(2),
063          AllianceStationID.RED_3, OptionalInt.of(3),
064          AllianceStationID.BLUE_1, OptionalInt.of(1),
065          AllianceStationID.BLUE_2, OptionalInt.of(2),
066          AllianceStationID.BLUE_3, OptionalInt.of(3));
067
068  /**
069   * Get the current alliance from the FMS.
070   *
071   * <p>If the FMS is not connected, it is set from the team alliance setting on the driver station.
072   *
073   * @return The alliance (red or blue) or an empty optional if the alliance is invalid
074   */
075  public static Optional<Alliance> getAlliance() {
076    AllianceStationID allianceStationID = DriverStationJNI.getAllianceStation();
077    if (allianceStationID == null) {
078      allianceStationID = AllianceStationID.UNKNOWN;
079    }
080
081    return m_allianceMap.get(allianceStationID);
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Gets the location of the team's driver station controls from the FMS.
086   *
087   * <p>If the FMS is not connected, it is set from the team alliance setting on the driver station.
088   *
089   * @return the location of the team's driver station controls: 1, 2, or 3
090   */
091  public static OptionalInt getLocation() {
092    AllianceStationID allianceStationID = DriverStationJNI.getAllianceStation();
093    if (allianceStationID == null) {
094      allianceStationID = AllianceStationID.UNKNOWN;
095    }
096
097    return m_stationMap.get(allianceStationID);
098  }
099
100  /**
101   * Get the replay number from the FMS.
102   *
103   * @return the replay number
104   */
105  public static int getReplayNumber() {
106    m_dataMutex.lock();
107    try {
108      return m_matchInfo.replayNumber;
109    } finally {
110      m_dataMutex.unlock();
111    }
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Get the match number from the FMS.
116   *
117   * @return the match number
118   */
119  public static int getMatchNumber() {
120    m_dataMutex.lock();
121    try {
122      return m_matchInfo.matchNumber;
123    } finally {
124      m_dataMutex.unlock();
125    }
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Get the match type from the FMS.
130   *
131   * @return the match type
132   */
133  public static MatchType getMatchType() {
134    int matchType;
135    m_dataMutex.lock();
136    try {
137      matchType = m_matchInfo.matchType;
138    } finally {
139      m_dataMutex.unlock();
140    }
141    return switch (matchType) {
142      case 1 -> MatchType.PRACTICE;
143      case 2 -> MatchType.QUALIFICATION;
144      case 3 -> MatchType.ELIMINATION;
145      default -> MatchType.NONE;
146    };
147  }
148
149  /**
150   * Get the event name from the FMS.
151   *
152   * @return the event name
153   */
154  public static String getEventName() {
155    m_dataMutex.lock();
156    try {
157      return m_matchInfo.eventName;
158    } finally {
159      m_dataMutex.unlock();
160    }
161  }
162
163  /**
164   * Get the game specific message from the FMS.
165   *
166   * <p>If the FMS is not connected, it is set from the game data setting on the driver station.
167   *
168   * @return the game specific message
169   */
170  public static Optional<String> getGameData() {
171    m_dataMutex.lock();
172    try {
173      if (m_gameData == null || m_gameData.isEmpty()) {
174        return Optional.empty();
175      }
176      return Optional.of(m_gameData);
177    } finally {
178      m_dataMutex.unlock();
179    }
180  }
181
182  /**
183   * Updates match info.
184   *
185   * @param gameData The current game data.
186   */
187  public static void refreshMatchInfo(String gameData) {
188    DriverStationJNI.getMatchInfo(m_matchInfoCache);
189    m_dataMutex.lock();
190    try {
191      var matchInfo = m_matchInfo;
192      m_matchInfo = m_matchInfoCache;
193      m_matchInfoCache = matchInfo;
194
195      m_gameData = gameData;
196    } finally {
197      m_dataMutex.unlock();
198    }
199  }
200}
